problem_text:
A shipping company must allocate cargo capacity across 7 distinct routes, each necessitating passage through 7 sequential logistical checkpoints. The revenue generated per ton of cargo dispatched on each route is as follows:
* For Route Alpha, revenue is 13.802 per ton
* For Route Beta, revenue is 19.109 per ton
* For Route Gamma, revenue is 17.918 per ton
* For Route Delta, revenue is 18.589 per ton
* For Route Epsilon, revenue is 5.812 per ton
* For Route Zeta, revenue is 18.461 per ton
* For Route Eta, revenue is 5.47 per ton

The handling duration required per ton of cargo at each checkpoint is detailed below:
*For Route Alpha, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.366 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.875 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.104 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.955 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.797 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.849 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.867 (ton-hours)
*For Route Beta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.314 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.486 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.81 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.449 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.962 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.383 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 0.694 (ton-hours)
*For Route Gamma, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.959 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.296 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.795 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.812 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.34 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.647 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 0.487 (ton-hours)
*For Route Delta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.394 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.666 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.487 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.294 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.958 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 0.486 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.863 (ton-hours)
*For Route Epsilon, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.579 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.435 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.663 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.594 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.402 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.592 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.71 (ton-hours)
*For Route Zeta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.544 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.068 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.436 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.38 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.576 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 0.672 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.613 (ton-hours)
*For Route Eta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.344 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.116 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.165 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.335 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.274 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 0.227 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.596 (ton-hours)

* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 1 must remain within 113.49 hours.
* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 2 must remain within 103.762 hours.
* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 3 must remain within 127.737 hours.
* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 4 must remain within 81.717 hours.
* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 5 must remain within 82.645 hours.
* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 6 must remain within 111.384 hours.
* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 7 must remain within 92.304 hours.

Given the imperative that the total processing time for each checkpoint—Checkpoint 1, Checkpoint 2, Checkpoint 3, Checkpoint 4, Checkpoint 5, Checkpoint 6, and Checkpoint 7—must not surpass its respective available capacity, determine the optimal cargo allocation across the routes to maximize total revenue.
